title: Verify JCache expiry callbacks and independent size maintenance
description: Observe both gets and the create/update/read callbacks in order after two puts of the same key. Check independent size and expiry profiles, and count survivors after maintenance without choosing a victim. Run the frozen application plan and compare cold, warm, clean and same-path production JAR replacement with qualified receipts.
expected: Source-bound public observations, cache actions and original receipts for each question. The relevant change matches the clean result or identifies the first open dependency.
